title: Autonomous fixed-wing interception using reinforcement learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.37470v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medium altitude, long endurance unmanned aerial systems such as Shahed-type strike drones are an unanswered threat in modern conflicts. Conventional air defense systems are too expensive to provide a feasible large-scale solution. Quadcopter interceptors are a cheap, battle-proven alternative, but their extremely limited flight time restricts them to low altitude targets at short range, whereas fixed-wing platforms have the endurance to reach higher altitude targets from longer distances. However, such interceptors are still operated manually. Recent developments in learning-based controllers show potential for automation. In this work, a fixed-wing interceptor is presented that is controlled by a neural network that maps filtered monocular vision observations directly to actuator commands. translated_title: 基于强化学习的固定翼自主拦截
translated_abstract: 中空长航时无人机系统，如Shahed型攻击无人机，是现代冲突中尚未得到有效应对的威胁。传统防空系统成本过高，难以提供可行的大规模解决方案。四旋翼拦截机是一种廉价且经过实战检验的替代方案，但其极其有限的飞行时间使其只能应对短距离、低高度的目标，而固定翼平台凭借其续航能力可以从更远的距离抵达更高高度的目标。然而，此类拦截机目前仍需人工操作。近年来基于学习的控制器的发展显示出实现自动化的潜力。在本工作中，提出了一种由神经网络控制的固定翼拦截机，该神经网络将滤波后的单目视觉观测直接映射为执行器指令。该策略在自定义的Python环境中使用强化学习和近端策略优化（PPO）进行训练，随后被部署于……
tldr: 本文提出一种由强化学习（PPO）训练的神经网络，将滤波后的单目视觉观测直接映射为执行器指令，从而实现固定翼拦截机对中空长航时无人机（如Shahed型）的自主拦截。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a fixed-wing interceptor controlled by a reinforcement learning (PPO) policy that maps filtered monocular vision observations directly to actuator commands, enabling autonomous interception of medium-altitude, long-endurance drones such as Shahed-type strike UAVs.
